info.title: Contact API
info.description: The Cloudflare Worker in `src/worker.ts` runs only for `/api/*` requests. Every other path is a static file from `dist/`. Any `/api/` path other than `/api/contact` answers 404 with an `Error` body.

servers.description: `npm run build`, then `npx wrangler dev` with `.dev.vars`

/api/contact.description: Every method other than POST answers 405 with an `Error` body.

post.summary: Send a contact form message by email
post.description: Forwards the message through Resend to `CONTACT_TO`, with the sender's address as reply-to. The checks run in this order: origin, body size, body parsing, honeypot, fields, configuration, rate limit, delivery. A JSON request gets a JSON answer. Any other content type is the form post a browser sends without JavaScript, and it gets a 303 redirect to a notice on `/contact/` instead.

requestBody.description: At most 20000 bytes by `Content-Length`. A post from another site is refused: the `Origin` header must match the request's origin, or without `Origin`, `Sec-Fetch-Site` must be `same-origin` or `none`.

200.description: Sent. A filled honeypot gets the same answer and sends nothing.

303.description: Form posts only. Redirects to the notice for the result: `#contact-sent` on success, `#contact-failed` for invalid input, `#contact-busy` for every other failure.

Location.description: The notice on `/contact/` of the request's origin.

400.description: A field is missing or breaks a rule, or the body cannot be read.

403.description: The post came from another site.

429.description: More than 5 valid messages from one IP address in 10 minutes. Invalid submissions do not count. The limit lives in Worker memory, so it resets on a cold start.

502.description: Resend could not be reached or refused the message. Resend's own error is never passed on.

503.description: `RESEND_API_KEY`, `CONTACT_FROM` or `CONTACT_TO` is not set. The message does not say which.

name.description: Every run of whitespace, line breaks included, becomes one space before the check, so the name cannot add a line to the email subject.

email.description: The reply-to address of the email.

company.description: Honeypot, hidden from people. Any value other than whitespace makes the Worker answer 200 and send nothing.

error.description: One sentence to show to the visitor.
